mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (id, reporter_id, target_id, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reporterId}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO blocks (id, blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{blockerId}, #{blockedId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks WHERE blocker_id = #{blockerId} AND blocked_id = #{blockedId})
